objective: sum over years of (1 + discount_rate)^-(order - 1) * (price * blend - sum over mines of royalty * open)

royalty.description: Royalty due for every year the mine is kept open, whether or not it is worked
royalty.label: yearly royalty

capacity.description: Most ore that can be extracted from the mine in a year in which it is worked
capacity.label: yearly extraction limit

quality.description: Grade of the mine's ore; grades blend linearly by tonnage
quality.label: ore quality

year.description: Year of the planning horizon (the notebook's years 1 to 5)
year.label: year

order.description: Position in the horizon (1 = first year). Revenue and royalties of the year are discounted by (1 + discount_rate)^-(order - 1); consecutive years are linked by the stay-closed rule
order.label: year number

quality_target.description: Grade the blended ore sold in the year must have exactly
quality_target.label: blended ore quality target

price.description: Selling price of the blended ore
price.label: ore selling price

max_mines.description: Maximum number of mines that may be worked in any one year
max_mines.label: maximum mines worked per year

discount_rate.description: Annual discount rate for revenue and royalties (0.1 = 10% per year)
discount_rate.label: annual discount rate

decision_variables.extract[year, mine]: tons of ore extracted from the mine in the year (>= 0)
decision_variables.operate[year, mine]: binary, 1 if the mine is worked in the year
decision_variables.open[year, mine]: binary, 1 if the mine is kept open in the year (royalty due)
decision_variables.blend[year]: tons of blended ore produced and sold in the year (>= 0)

constraints.stay_closed[year, mine]: open[year] <= open[previous year] for every year after the first (a closed mine never reopens)

operate.label: mine-years worked (0/1 per mine and year)

open.label: mine-years kept open (0/1 per mine and year)
